review_scope: Civil expert-evidence subset: ZPP Articles 250–260 in the official 2011 consolidated publication. Later amendments were not fully traced; no criminal route or oath formula has been validated.

appointment.summary_en: The court uses expert evidence for factual issues requiring specialist knowledge and determines the expert.

questions.summary_en: The court directs the examination, identifies the object and questions, and may seek clarification.

items_en: Oral evidence or a written report as directed by the court.

rights_duties.summary_en: Examine carefully, record observations accurately and explain the opinion in accordance with scientific and professional rules.

statute.title_en: Civil Procedure Act; official consolidated publication NN 148/2011

timestamp.qualified_recognition: Qualified timestamps carry date/time accuracy and data-integrity presumptions; qualification requires the statutory conditions.

open_questions: Provider qualification, certificate status, national filing rules and supported signature formats must be checked separately; this profile does not qualify a TgWitness signature or timestamp.
Trace all amendments affecting the cited civil provisions before case-specific use; the 2011 consolidation is not represented as the current complete statute.
Criminal expert appointment, report requirements and any applicable warning must be checked against the current Zakon o kaznenom postupku. The civil route must not be substituted.
Report requirements are summarised in English. Native expert/law terms do not imply a complete reviewed translation of the report or interface.
court_language_notes: Croatian is the general court language; minority-language rights depend on the court territory and applicable legislation. This list is not an exhaustive statement of those rights.
